name: shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: A button with a light that circles its edge. Stops when disabled or under reduced motion.

props.name: shimmerColor
props.description: Color of the light that circles the edge. Any CSS color.

props.name: shimmerSize
props.description: Thickness of the lit edge in pixels.

props.name: background
props.description: Fill of the button. Any CSS color or gradient.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the light to circle the button once.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button and stops the shimmer.
